summary.intent: Fix the `entire skill` command not finding session data despite the insightsdb containing 2364 sessions, 45 skill_signals, and 520 Skill tool calls.
summary.outcome: Fixed three root causes: stale cache key not invalidating when facets are backfilled (v6 composite key), name resolution failures for LLM-extracted names with spaces/parentheses, and zero observability into the populate pipeline. All new tests pass.

repo: The skilldb cache key was `v5:<branch_tip>` — the branch tip only changes when new checkpoints are ingested, NOT when `entire insights` backfills facets (which populates skill_signals). This race condition caused the cache to appear fresh while containing 0 rows.

LLM-extracted skill signal names can include parenthetical suffixes like 'superpowers:brainstorming (visual companion)' — the old ResolveSkillName only recognized `-` and `:` as word boundaries, causing silent match failures.
TestDiscoverSkills failures are pre-existing and not isolated (they pick up real plugin files from ~/.claude/plugins/cache/), making them environment-dependent rather than hermetic.
The memorylooptui package had pre-existing lint/compile errors unrelated to skill changes.
insightsdb backfills facets after setting the branch tip, creating a window where skilldb cache is stale but considers itself fresh.

code.finding: ResolveSkillName rule 4 (last-segment boundary matching) only checked `-` and `:` as delimiters. Added space and `(` as boundaries, plus new rule 3b to strip parenthetical suffixes before matching.

PopulateFromInsightsDB returned only `error`, making it impossible to diagnose which pipeline stage (skill discovery, signal fetch, transcript read, insert) dropped rows. Refactored to return `*PopulateResult` with counters at each stage.
Added GetContentFingerprint() — a lightweight SQL query returning row counts from sessions, skill_signals, tool_calls, and facets tables — used to build a composite cache key.
Empty state in picker showed no diagnostic info. Now threads PopulateResult through dataLoadedMsg and displays pipeline stage counts when 0 sessions are found.
dataLoadedMsg gained a populateResult field to carry pipeline diagnostic counts from the data loading goroutine to the TUI update handler.

workflow: TDD (RED→GREEN) was applied to ResolveSkillName: writing failing tests first prevented accidentally breaking the 8 existing boundary-matching cases while adding 2 new ones.
Bumping the cache version string (v5→v6) is a reliable way to force a one-time full cache refresh after changing matching logic — avoids stale cache serving users bad data after upgrade.
Returning structured result types from pipeline functions (vs. just logging) makes diagnostics actionable in the UI without requiring users to inspect log files.
Verifying pre-existing test failures on main branch before concluding they are unrelated to changes is important hygiene when using `go test ./...`.

friction: The cache falsely reported itself as up-to-date (tip matched) while containing 0 rows — zero observability made root cause diagnosis require extensive bash inspection of raw sqlite tables.
PopulateFromInsightsDB had no return value or logging, making it a complete black box when it silently inserted 0 rows.
Pre-existing TestDiscoverSkills failures polluted test output, requiring manual verification they predated the changes.
The maintidx lint warning on PopulateFromInsightsDB (complexity too high) cannot be cleanly resolved without a larger refactor — lint was noisy but not blocking.
Multiple round-trips were needed to edit cache.go correctly due to the large function body requiring sequential reads between edits.
open_items: TestDiscoverSkills tests are not hermetic — they read real ~/.claude/plugins/cache/ files. Should be fixed to use temp dirs for home directory isolation.
PopulateFromInsightsDB complexity (maintidx lint warning) — could be refactored into smaller helper functions but was deferred as out of scope.

The Files Modified list in the transcript includes memoryloop* files that were not described as changed in the session — unclear if these were pre-existing changes in the worktree or unintended modifications.
Consider adding an integration test that verifies PopulateFromInsightsDB actually inserts rows when skill_signals exist in insightsdb, to catch future regressions in the name resolution pipeline.
